description: Server-side security: the local UserDir router registers its /{path} catch-all BEFORE the documented /api/v2/users route, so first-match routing shadows the contract endpoint behind the catch-all 404 page. Reproduce on the live server, reorder the routing so the documented endpoint serves while unknown paths keep the catch-all, make the provided API suite pass and report the shadowed endpoint. Needs http_request against the live fixture server.

criteria: The agent showed on the live server that GET /api/v2/users returns the catch-all 404 despite being documented, then reordered ROUTES in server/app.py so the exact routes are matched before the /{path} catch-all: the user list serves with its dept filter, unknown paths keep the catch-all 404, and openapi.json is served unchanged.

python3 tests/api_test.py passes all 7 checks, report/shadow.md carries shadowed_endpoint = /api/v2/users, catchall_position = first and a fixed_by line, and the contract, the test suite and the README are untouched.
